Daily Devotional

September 12

7 Rooted and built up in him, and stablished in the faith, as ye have been taught, abounding therein with thanksgiving. (Colossians 2:7 KJV)

When we are born again, we receive the faith of God (Ephesians 2:8). We still must get rooted and built up in our new faith, and one of the primary ways of doing that is with thanksgiving. Being thankful is a very powerful force in the Christian life, and if you have the love of God flowing in you, you will be thankful. No one can have strong faith without being thankful (Psalms 100:4).

Notice that this is using the seed principal that is so common throughout the Bible, as it is talking about being rooted in faith. Like so much else in our Christian life, faith is like a seed that God has planted in us when we are saved and it must take root and grow to be fruitful. Faith works by love (Galatians 5:6), and without constant praise and thankfulness, mixed with our love for God, faith cannot grow and become mature. You don’t have to have a big amount of faith (Matthew 17:20), but it needs to be mature and not be offset by lots of unbelief, for you to experience the victorious life that God wants His children to have. Remember you get unbelief by hearing the things of this world, as you can not love the world and God at the same time (1 John 2:15). Thank you Lord!

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com

I have spent a while working on a set of C++ tools for easy development of multi-threaded, distributed data analysis. I hope someone finds it useful. Constructive criticism is welcome, patches doubly so.

Daily Devotional

September 12

7 Rooted and built up in him, and stablished in the faith, as ye have been taught, abounding therein with thanksgiving. (Colossians 2:7 KJV)

When we are born again, we receive the faith of God (Ephesians 2:8). We still must get rooted and built up in our new faith, and one of the primary ways of doing that is with thanksgiving. Being thankful is a very powerful force in the Christian life, and if you have the love of God flowing in you, you will be thankful. No one can have strong faith without being thankful (Psalms 100:4).

Notice that this is using the seed principal that is so common throughout the Bible, as it is talking about being rooted in faith. Like so much else in our Christian life, faith is like a seed that God has planted in us when we are saved and it must take root and grow to be fruitful. Faith works by love (Galatians 5:6), and without constant praise and thankfulness, mixed with our love for God, faith cannot grow and become mature. You don’t have to have a big amount of faith (Matthew 17:20), but it needs to be mature and not be offset by lots of unbelief, for you to experience the victorious life that God wants His children to have. Remember you get unbelief by hearing the things of this world, as you can not love the world and God at the same time (1 John 2:15). Thank you Lord!
